The petitioner alleges inaction of the police  authorities.

The learned Advocate for the petitioner  submits that the police authorities have not taken  effective steps to conduct investigation in respect of  the complaint made by the petitioner, who is the  father of the victim, on October 13, 2022.

Mr. Mitra, learned Advocate for the State files a  written instruction given to him by the concerned  Investigating Officer, wherefrom it appears that the  FIR was registered on the basis of the complaint made Tushar Naskar vs State Of West Bengal And Others on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156846998/
1  by the petitioner on October 13, 2022. Charge-sheet  has been submitted vide Baruipur Women Police  Station Charge Sheet No. 39/23 date: 21.05.2023  under Sections 376(2)(n)/506/342/323 IPC and 6 of  the POCSO Act.

sentences.text: It further appears therefrom that the  2 supplementary charge-sheet will be submitted after completion of investigation of the case after arrest of the respondent nos.6 and 7 as per the provisions laid down under Section 173(8) of the Criminal Procedure Code.

The learned Advocate for the petitioner submits that the charge-sheet was filed after the filing of the writ petition and the provision of the relevant statue provides that the trial is to be completed within a specified time.

Since after completion of investigation, charge-sheet has already been filed and the learned Judge, Special Court (POCSO Act) at Baruipur, South 24 Parganas is in seisin over the matter, this writ petition is disposed of by observing that the trial is to be completed as expeditiously as possible strictly in accordance with law.
